name: svg_drawing
description: How DXF content is drawn as SVG for the electrical editor (vpt/dxf_svg.py). One home for these values.
note: Integer coordinates: one viewBox unit = svg_model_resolution_mm of the MODEL (when the drawing's units are known), else svg_paper_resolution_mm of the page; the long side has between svg_min_units and svg_max_units units.
